  fderiv 𝕜 f x 1

\[ \frac{d}{dy} y^r = r \cdot y^{r - 1} \]

The conditions \( x \neq 0 \) and \( r \neq 0 \) ensure that the expression \( x^{r - 1} \) is well-defined and avoids indeterminate forms or singularities in the complex plane.
